description.zh: 把一台 ComfyUI(本机或局域网)接进 Mosael:它保存的每张工作流既是一个图像 / 视频生成模型,也是一个工具(「工作流 · 名字」,入参就是那张图自己的提示词、读素材的节点和可调参数,交回全部产出)。另有列出工作流与模型文件、看显卡和队列、把历史产出收进素材库、中断 / 清队列 / 释放显存。
description.en: Connect a ComfyUI server (local or on your LAN): every saved workflow is both an image / video generation model and a tool (“Workflow · name”, whose inputs are that graph's own prompts, loader nodes and tunable parameters, returning every output). Plus listing workflows and model files, GPU and queue status, importing past outputs into the asset library, and interrupt / clear queue / free VRAM.

help.zh: 本机默认是 http://127.0.0.1:8188;填局域网地址就能用另一台机器的显卡。多台服务器就建多个连接。
help.en: http://127.0.0.1:8188 on this machine; a LAN address uses another machine's GPU. One connection per server.

help.zh: 转换认不出的工作流的退路:在 ComfyUI 里「导出 (API)」,把得到的 JSON 贴在这里,它在模型列表里叫「API 模板」。可用占位符 `{{prompt}}` `{{negative}}` `{{seed}}` `{{width}}` `{{height}}` `{{steps}}`。
help.en: A fallback for workflows the converter can't read: use “Export (API)” in ComfyUI and paste the JSON here; it appears as “API template” in the model list. Placeholders: `{{prompt}}` `{{negative}}` `{{seed}}` `{{width}}` `{{height}}` `{{steps}}`.

description.zh: 替 Mosael 在这台 ComfyUI 上列出模型与工具(每张工作流一个)、做一次生成。只给宿主调。
description.en: Lists models and tools (one per workflow) and runs generations on this ComfyUI server for Mosael. Host-only.

description.zh: 这台 ComfyUI 上保存的每张工作流:能喂什么(图 / 蒙版 / 视频 / 音频各接在哪个节点)、能调什么、会交出什么、看起来在做什么(放大、局部重绘、抠图…)。先用它挑一张,再用 run_workflow 跑。
description.en: Every workflow saved on this ComfyUI: what it takes (which node loads each image / mask / video / audio), what can be tuned, what it outputs, and what it seems to do (upscale, inpaint, background removal…). Pick one here, then run it with run_workflow.

description.zh: 只看 id 或名字里带这几个字的
description.en: Only workflows whose id or name contains this

description.zh: 给智能体的退路:按 id 原样跑任意一张工作流,输入用通用的几个参数(`image` / `images` / `mask` / `video` / `audio`,`values` 改任意节点的值)。**每张工作流都有自己的工具**(「工作流 · 名字」,入参就是它自己的节点),优先用那个;这个工具的长处是 `wait: false` 只提交、之后用 import_outputs 取回。
description.en: An escape hatch for the agent: run any workflow by id with generic inputs (`image` / `images` / `mask` / `video` / `audio`, `values` for any node). **Every workflow has its own tool** (“Workflow · name”, whose inputs are that workflow's own nodes) — prefer it; this one is for `wait: false` submit-now, fetch-later with import_outputs.

description.zh: list_workflows 里的 id(保存的工作流是它在 ComfyUI 里的路径,如 upscale.json;另有 builtin:txt2img 和 api-workflow)
description.en: An id from list_workflows (a saved workflow's path in ComfyUI such as upscale.json; also builtin:txt2img and api-workflow)

description.zh: 写进正向提示词节点;不填就用工作流里写好的
description.en: Goes into the positive prompt node; leave empty to keep the workflow's own

description.zh: 写进反向提示词节点;不填就用工作流里写好的
description.en: Goes into the negative prompt node; empty keeps the workflow's own

description.zh: 第一个读图节点(LoadImage)的图
description.en: Image for the first image loader (LoadImage)

description.zh: 其余读图节点的图,按 list_workflows 里的顺序
description.en: Images for the remaining image loaders, in list_workflows order

description.zh: 局部重绘的蒙版(白色是要改的地方)。没有单独的蒙版节点时接到 LoadImage 的 alpha 那一路
description.en: Inpainting mask (white = area to change). Without a separate mask loader it replaces LoadImage's alpha output

description.zh: 读视频节点(LoadVideo / VHS_LoadVideo)的视频
description.en: Video for the video loader (LoadVideo / VHS_LoadVideo)

description.zh: 读音频节点(LoadAudio)的音频
description.en: Audio for the audio loader (LoadAudio)

description.zh: 写进每个采样器的种子;不填就用工作流存着的
description.en: Written into every sampler seed; empty keeps the workflow's

description.zh: 画布宽度,只对有画布节点的工作流
description.en: Canvas width, for workflows with a latent / canvas node

description.zh: 画布高度,只对有画布节点的工作流
description.en: Canvas height, for workflows with a latent / canvas node

description.zh: 改任意节点上的值:{"3.steps": 30, "采样.cfg": 6} —— 键是「节点 id 或节点标题.输入名」
description.en: Override any literal input: {"3.steps": 30, "Sampler.cfg": 6} — keys are “node id or node title.input name”

description.zh: 默认等它跑完并取回产出;false = 只提交,交回任务号
description.en: Default waits and collects the outputs; false only submits and returns the task id

description.zh: 也取回 PreviewImage 这类预览节点的临时文件(有保存节点时默认不取)
description.en: Also collect temporary files from preview nodes (skipped by default when the workflow has save nodes)

description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 历史里的产出收进素材库:给任务号就取那一个(还在跑可以等一会儿),不给就取最近几次。在 ComfyUI 界面里跑出来的东西也能这样拿回来。
description.en: Imports outputs from ComfyUI's history into the asset library: a task id fetches that one (optionally waiting while it runs), otherwise the most recent runs. Also works for things run directly in the ComfyUI interface.

description.zh: run_workflow 交回的任务号,或 ComfyUI 历史里的;不填就按「最近几次」
description.en: A task id from run_workflow or ComfyUI's history; empty = most recent runs

description.zh: 不给任务号时取最近几次,默认 1
description.en: Without a task id: how many recent runs, default 1

description.zh: 任务还没跑完时最多等几秒,默认不等
description.en: How long to wait for an unfinished task, default 0

description.zh: 也取回预览节点的临时文件
description.en: Also collect temporary files from preview nodes

description.zh: ComfyUI 的版本、显卡与空闲显存、内存,以及队列里在跑 / 排队的任务数。
description.en: ComfyUI version, GPU and free VRAM, RAM, and how many tasks are running / queued.

description.zh: 服务器上装了哪些模型文件,按目录分:checkpoints、loras、vae、upscale_models、controlnet、diffusion_models…
description.en: Model files installed on the server by folder: checkpoints, loras, vae, upscale_models, controlnet, diffusion_models…

description.zh: 只看这一个目录,如 loras
description.en: Only this folder, e.g. loras

description.zh: 停下 ComfyUI 正在跑的任务。给了任务号就只停那一个(在跑的中断,排队的删掉),不会误伤别人的任务。
description.en: Stops the task ComfyUI is running. With a task id only that one is stopped (interrupted if running, removed if queued), leaving other people's tasks alone.

description.zh: 只停这一个任务
description.en: Only stop this task

description.zh: 清掉 ComfyUI 里所有**排队中**的任务(在跑的不动)。同一台服务器上别人排的任务也会被清掉。
description.en: Clears every **queued** task in ComfyUI (the running one is untouched). Tasks queued by other people on the same server are cleared too.

description.zh: 让 ComfyUI 卸载模型、释放显存。下一次生成要重新加载模型,会慢一些。
description.en: Asks ComfyUI to unload models and free VRAM. The next run reloads its models and is slower.

description.zh: 同时卸载模型,默认是
description.en: Also unload models, default true
